warnings: *** THIS SHEET SUPPLIES THE TREAD AND RISER THAT STRUCTURAL SHEET S-14 EXPLICITLY REFUSED TO GIVE. *** S-14 replaced every step dimension with 'ระยะลูกนอน/ลูกตั้งตามแบบสถาปัตยกรรม'; here they are: 10 ลูกตั้ง @0.15 per flight and 9 ลูกนอน @0.275 per flight. The S-14 flag tread_riser_deferred_to_architectural is resolved by this sheet.
THE ARITHMETIC CLOSES ON THE ELEVATIONS: 20 risers x 0.15 = 3.00 m, exactly the +0.40 to +3.40 floor-to-floor from A-08. And 1.225 + 2.475 + 1.30 = 5.00 m, exactly the grid D-C bay.
A 0.15 m RISER WITH A 0.275 m TREAD IS DELIBERATELY SHALLOW -- this is the accessible-housing brief from A-03 showing up in the geometry. A conventional Thai house stair would be nearer 0.175-0.20 m.

The 2.40 m stairwell splits as 0.20 / 0.90 / 0.225 / 0.90 -- two 0.90 m flights with a 0.225 m gap. That 2.40 is the same figure as the 2.40 / 0.20 / 2.40 sub-chain on the floor plans and on structural sheet S-04, so architecture and structure agree on the well.
Handrail height 0.90 m is dimensioned three times. Note this is the STAIR rail; A-03 sets the RAMP rail at 0.80 m above the ramp, a different figure for a different place.
Two enlargements are called out from here, ดูขยาย 1 and ดูขยาย 2, both on A-17.
Step numbering differs between the two plans -- 1 to 15 on the ground-floor plan (cut at the usual 1.2 m plan height) and 1 to 20 on the upper one. Same stair, standard convention.
